title.narrative: Wastewater and Solid Waste Treatment Capacity Building Project, Phase 2

description.narrative: Active

Lao team will prepare a project concept paper/ proposal in the amount of USD 10 million to be submitted to KOICA Laos in 2021. The proposal will aim to support the implementation of GG related agenda laid out in the 9th National Socioeconomic Development Plan including renewable energy, energy efficiency, EVs, waste management, and sanitation.
